The Circle (2015 film) | The Circle (original title: "Cirkeln") is a Swedish fantasy film produced and scored by Benny Andersson and directed and co-written by Levan Akin, based on the best-selling novel "The Circle" by Sara Bergmark Elfgren and Mats Strandberg.  It is the first in an intended trilogy of films based on "Engelsfors".  A film adaptation was to be produced by Filmlance in 2013, with Levan Akin set to direct and Bergmark Elfgren as script writer.  The production was put on hold due to disagreements between the authors and Filmlance.  Akin left the project as well. Open castings for young girls who could play the leads were held all over Sweden.
